mobbin:06bcb061-a16d-4a6f-95bd-8c5e31c5f.summary: In a live huddle, the user opens More options, turns on push-to-talk, then uses a large hold-to-speak control that replaces ordinary mute.
steps: PTT idle — muted mic overlay + dismiss X
Hold-to-talk ready — large green mic button
Hold-to-talk engaged — mic button with ripple
steal: Explicit mode switch 'Turn on push-to-talk' during an active session (step 1) — PTT is a mode, not a permanent mute replacement.
Idle overlay: struck mic + 'Push-to-talk' label + X to exit mode (step 2) — clear waiting-to-speak state.
Oversized hold target at the bottom (steps 3–4) — speak without hunting a tiny toolbar icon.
Ripple/press feedback on the mic button (step 4) — confirms the channel is open while held.
avoid: Burying PTT under More → option for faculty who talk into rooms constantly (step 1) — primary room/simulator talk should stay one tap away.
mobbin:06bcb061-a16d-4a6f-95bd-8c5e31c5f.fit: Pattern for the live intercom / voice-of-manikin control beside SRV (not Transcript): hold-to-talk mode with idle vs open states during an active session.

mobbin:5a85acae-251f-4a89-8b61-20b3dc15a.summary: From Workflow templates, the user sets a scheduled standup that starts at a fixed time, is blocked until a recipient is chosen, then saves a previewed message step.
steps: Templates — pick scheduled date & time standup
Send a message modal — missing channel, Save disabled
Send a message modal — channel selected + preview
Canvas — message step complete + updated toast
steal: Templates labeled by trigger type ('Scheduled date & time') (step 1) — operators pick how it starts, not a blank builder.
'Needs attention' + pink step until recipient is set; Save stays disabled (steps 2–3) — cannot publish an untargeted announce.
Linear Start → Then steps with Edit on each block (steps 2, 5) — reschedule or retarget mid-setup without rebuilding.
Inline message preview before Publish (steps 4–5) — see exact wording that will hit the room.
avoid: General-purpose multi-step Workflow Builder for a one-shot scheduled room cue (steps 1–5) — overkill vs a simple schedule + target + message form.
mobbin:5a85acae-251f-4a89-8b61-20b3dc15a.fit: Informs scheduled auto-announce (and by analogy ~5am self-test / auto-record) outside SRV: time trigger, required target, preview — not Annotation/Data Entry tabs.
